title: Обман деда раскрыт  (Grandpa's Trick Is Exposed)

segments.t: At the bar, Vika gently pulls Max aside to break the sad news that his grandmother has only two months left to live. When Max blurts out 'Grandma too?!', the two of them realize that the sly grandfather told each of them a different lie just to drink and eat meat.
Мне дед сказал, что это ему осталось два месяца!
Теперь хотя бы понятно, в кого ты такой.
Now let's go back through their conversation line by line and unpack the Russian phrasing.
'Max, we need to talk.' The meaning hinges on 'Max' working together with 'to talk' in spoken Russian.
'Let us not do it right now.' In Russian, the idea of 'come on' flows naturally into 'now' without extra filler words.
'You must know something.' Vika addresses the listener with the informal singular 'you' alongside 'to know'.
'Your grandmother is seriously ill.' Vika brings out the contrast between 'your' and 'old lady' in a few short words.
'She has a couple of months left.' In Russian, the idea of 'to her' flows naturally into 'months' without extra filler words.
'Grandma too?' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'old lady' and finishing on 'also'. Vika answers right away.
'Yes, Maxim Ilyich said so.' Vika anchors the line on 'yes', while 'said' completes the thought.
'Wait, what does 'too' mean?' The grammar packs 'wait' and 'also' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange.
Мне дед сказал, что это ему осталось два месяца!
'Grandpa told me that he is the one with two months left!' The '-l' ending on the verb meaning 'said' places the action in the masculine past tense. Vika answers right away.
'He fooled both of us!' The grammar packs 'he' and 'to cheat' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange.
Теперь хотя бы понятно, в кого ты такой.
'Now at least it is clear who you take after.' The meaning hinges on 'now' working together with 'such' in spoken Russian.
'Grandpa, we need to have a serious talk!' An emphatic spoken line centered on the verb meaning 'to talk'. Alright, let's hear the entire conversation one more time from start to finish.
Мне дед сказал, что это ему осталось два месяца!
Теперь хотя бы понятно, в кого ты такой.
And that finishes the revelation at the bar. Listen for Vika's dry joke that now she knows who Max takes after as they head upstairs to confront his grandfather. Until next time!
